title: Rendley agent run results
description: One item per run. The agent job's fields appear under their own names with the raw job as agent_job, and the render job's output is flattened with the raw job as export_job.

status.description: started when the run started the job and exited, running when the job was still going (a job_id run found it running, or a waiting run reached its timeout), completed or failed once it ended.

error.description: Why the run failed, when status is failed.

project_id.description: The Rendley project the agent edited.

created_project.description: Whether this run created the project.

thread_id.description: Agent conversation thread; pass it back with project_id to continue.

last_message.description: The agent's final message, as last_message on the agent job.

commands_failed.description: Editing commands the agent could not apply.

agent_job.description: The agent job exactly as the Rendley API returns it from GET /agent/jobs/{id}.

note.description: What happened when the run did not finish with a video: the job was started or is still running (pick it up with job_id), exporting was off, or the agent made no changes.

url.description: Signed download URL of the rendered video, the same as the job's output.url in the Rendley API. Expires after a few hours.

size.description: Size of the rendered file in bytes.

duration.description: Duration of the rendered video in seconds.

kvs_key.description: Key of the copy stored in the run's key-value store.

result_data.description: The render job's result_data from the Rendley API, parsed.

export_job.description: The render job exactly as the Rendley API returns it from GET /jobs/{id}.
